tweets.text: Cold plunge or red light therapy — which one should you actually buy first for sore muscles? We ran the logic (and the budget math) so you don't have to guess. 🧵

Quick breakdown:
❄️ Cold plunge → best for acute inflammation, post-heavy-training soreness, mental toughness bonus
🔴 Red light → best for chronic stiffness, joint pain, gentler on the body, easier daily use
💰 Budget: red light panels start lower, cold plunges run higher
📏 Space: red light needs less floor space — works in small rentals

Before: guessing which $500-$1,000 recovery tool to buy and hoping it fixes YOUR kind of soreness.
After: matching your specific pain pattern (acute vs chronic, budget, space) to the right tool first — then buying with confidence.
Also: heart condition, Raynaud's, or pregnant? Talk to your doctor before either one.

Full comparison + our top 3 picks (Cold Pod 2.0, Hooga HG300, PlatinumLED BioMax 300) with the matching table and medical precautions here: https://lionlion0201-jpg.github.io/home-recovery-blog/posts/cold-plunge-vs-red-light-therapy/
